title: Borders and territories: uti possidetis
goal: I can explain the principle of uti possidetis and why it still caused border disputes.
grammar: Reporting information: borders and the sources

items: I can explain the principle of uti possidetis.
I can say why many colonial limits were unclear.
I can report what governments said about the colonial documents.
I can give one example of a long border dispute and how it ended.
I can use según and decir que to report what a source says.
